I need to write a JavaScript function that computes a running total of an array of non-negative numbers, capped at a given positive value. Once the cumulative sum reaches the cap, all subsequent positions should remain at the cap.

I drafted two implementations. The first uses a boolean flag to freeze the running total once it hits the cap. The second uses `Math.min(total + num, cap)` in a single loop.
